consumers.Technical Artist: render + encode every `process[].render_cmd`, then `encode` steps; write outputs under assets/audio/
consumers.Game Developer: src/core/audio.js loads `cues` (file_ogg/file_aac relative to assets/audio/), implements `mixer`, `event_routing`, `music_state_machine`

mixer.volume_curve: gain_dB(v) = 40*log10(v / v_default), clamp <= +4 dB; v = 0 is hard mute. Defaults master 80, music 70, sfx 90, ui 80 = 0 dB.
fire_order: step coalescing: one voice per cue per 16.67 ms sim step; +1.5 dB per doubling of count, cap +3 dB
sub-bus cap then global cap: steal lowest priority (ties oldest) only if new priority >= victim; never_victim voices are never stolen
every stolen voice: 15 ms linear ramp to 0, then stop()
mixer.positional: pan = clamp((x - camera.midX) / 320, -1, 1) * spatial.width (0.5 world/enemy, 0.25 player-originated)

D7_low_hp.combine: with D6 use the lower cutoff

ducks.combine_rule: several ducks on one bus: apply the deepest, never the sum; setTargetAtTime ramps; hold measured from trigger
ducks.fallback: if the BiquadFilter on music is not clean in Phaser routing, drop the filter part of D6/D7 and keep the gain moves

defence_chip.rule: a request is dropped if any group member started < 100 ms ago, if 2 group voices sound, or if any sfx.critical voice started < 150 ms ago
defence_chip.why: ~10 blocks/s -> <= 10 starts/s at -28/-29 LUFS each (2 voices ~ -25); player_hurt is -15 and D2 ducks sfx.impact a further -4 dB: >= 14 dB separation, and the 150 ms critical window keeps the hurt transient in the clear

mixer.platform_session: navigator.audioSession.type='ambient' (guarded): the game mixes under the player's own music and obeys the iOS silent switch. Nothing in the mix may depend on sub-bass or on being the only audio: every sfx_critical and loop keeps small-speaker loss <= 6 dB (encode.step_8), and no cue relies on loudness above its mix target.

event_routing.cast: cast_<element of the first spell fired this cast step>; + cast_multicast_layer if shots >= 3; + cast_heavy_layer if heavy (group has `heavy` modifier or spell in {comet, fireball, frost_lance, thunder_orb}). One routing per cast step, never per projectile.
event_routing.hit_enemy: hit_<element>; elementless damage (reaction, relic explode) routes nothing (its own cue covers it)

kill.fire_imp: self-destruct or killed mid-fuse -> explode_small (no kill cue)
kill.natives: drowned -> kill_drowned, paper -> kill_paper; ink_imp self-destruct or killed mid-fuse -> explode_ink (like fire_imp -> explode_small)

event_routing.explode: radiusPx >= bigExplosionRadiusPx (40) ? explode_big : explode_small; relic explode uses the same rule; boss unravel bursts -> explode_small with gain offset -9 dB
event_routing.chain_zap: chain_zap (chain modifier arcs and thunder_orb zap ticks)
event_routing.door_close: door_close (+ music COMBAT transition after rules.waves.roomEnterGraceMs)
event_routing.run_start: run_start (+ amb_cave start, EXPLORE); mode daily -> daily_start instead of run_start
event_routing.enemy_windup: windup_<type> for melee_swipe->swipe, shoot, ring, spiral, charge, slam, summon, blink, self_destruct; hazard -> windup_hazard_acid (acid_pools) | windup_hazard_fire (fire_zones); ward_allies -> windup_ward; guard -> windup_guard; mirror -> windup_mirror; hazard bone_rain -> windup_hazard_bone
event_routing.enemy_release: melee_swipe->release_swipe, shoot->release_shoot, ring->release_ring (per volley), spiral->release_ring (once, at start), charge->enemy_charge_go, slam(target)->enemy_leap, slam(self)->heavy_impact, summon->enemy_summon_rise, blink->enemy_blink_out then enemy_blink_in at W+1, self_destruct->explode_small, hazard->hazard_on_acid|hazard_on_fire; ward_allies -> ward_raise; guard -> guard_raise; mirror -> release_shoot; hazard bone_rain -> hazard_on_bone; self_destruct(ink_imp) -> explode_ink
event_routing.boss_activate: tier boss: boss_roar_<knight|queen|lich> + stg_boss_intro (+ music BOSS_P1); tier mini: miniboss_roar_<warden|matron|colossus> + stg_miniboss_intro (music: the combat bed keeps playing; no boss bed for minis)
event_routing.boss_phase: tier boss: boss_roar_<boss> + stg_boss_phase (+ music next phase); tier mini (P2): miniboss_roar_<mini> + ward_raise/armour/shield regrow cue per its defence; no stinger
event_routing.boss_death: tier boss: boss_death (+ stg_boss_clear or stg_victory at +600 ms); tier mini: miniboss_death, then the room_clear release (stg_room_clear at +600 ms)

armour.hit otherwise (direct x0.4 / DoT x0.25): armour_clang_chip (rate_group defence_chip; DoT ticks route nothing)

defence.first_block_tip: silent (the tip is visual; the block cue already played)

event_routing.boss_adapt: stg_boss_adapt; mercy adapts (mercy_shield/_ward/_armour) at gain offset -6 dB

event_routing.goal_earned: stg_goal (run-end payouts: one per goal, 900 ms apart, after the run-end stinger ends)
event_routing.reward_reroll: ui_reroll (the same verb as the shop reroll; one sound for one action)
event_routing.touch_ui_tap: touch_ui_tap on touch-down of any touch control or menu item (min 80 ms); menus still play ui_confirm / ui_back on release-over-same

EXPLORE.enter_from_title: title out 1000 ms, explore in 2000 ms
EXPLORE.on: run_start, room_enter{kind in start, landing, treasure, shop}, after room_clear

COMBAT.crossfade: EQUAL-POWER 1200 ms explore->combat: g_out = cos(t*pi/2), g_in = sin(t*pi/2). Explore PAUSES (keeps position) when its fade ends; the combat bed RESUMES from its last position (first combat of a world starts at 0).
COMBAT.note: door_close slam + wave_spawn mask the crossfade

RELEASE.timeline: t=0 stg_room_clear (D3); combat bed fades out 600 ms then pauses (keeps position); t=400 ms explore resumes with a 2500 ms fade-in (equal-power curve)

BOSS.enter: boss room: explore fades out over bossIntroPanMs 900 ms; at boss_activate roar + stg_boss_intro, then *_p1 starts at sample 0 when the stinger ends
BOSS.phase: boss_phase: current bed fades 300 ms from t=0; stg_boss_phase + roar; next bed starts at sample 0 at t=900 ms with 100 ms fade-in
BOSS.down: boss_death: bed fades 400 ms; stg_boss_clear (F1-F2) or stg_victory (F3) at +600 ms; F1-F2: EXPLORE resumes 2000 ms after stinger start (3000 ms fade); F3: run-end then TITLE after the stinger

DEATH.timeline: D8 (beds out 700 ms, ambience out 1200 ms); stg_death at +400 ms; TITLE after the stinger

FLOOR.rule: the current world explore bed + ambience fade out over the descend (1500 ms); floor_descend SFX at sink start; at the world card: stg.world.<next> (D3), then music.world.<next>.explore fades in over 2000 ms from the stinger end and amb.world.<next> fades in over 1500 ms. The v1 floor-2 amb_cave detune rule is retired (W2 has its own ambience).

music_state_machine.cycle_safety: a transition arriving mid-crossfade retargets ramps from current values; room_clear never fires in BOSS; stingers newest_replaces_oldest

load_groups.boot: all sfx, ui, stingers (~16 MB decoded incl. v1.2 cues)
load_groups.title: mus_title — unload when a run starts
load_groups.boss_a: mus_boss_a_p1/p2 — load on floor 1-2 boss-room entry (during the 900 ms pan), unload after boss_death
load_groups.boss_final: mus_boss_final_p1..p3 — load on floor 3 boss-room entry, unload mus_combat_b first
load_groups.world_w1: mus_explore, mus_combat_a, amb_cave — load at run start
load_groups.world_switch: at the floor boss death: unload the world combat bed, then the boss group after its stinger; at floor_descend start: load world_<next> (decode is covered by the ~2-3 s descend + world card; if a bed is not ready when the card ends, it starts on decode with its 2000 ms fade-in); unload world_<prev> when the next explore bed is audible. Peak (W2 -> W3): ~80 MB loops + ~16 MB one-shots.
